We're launching our media product and expect over 500,000 users. We want a microservices platform running on AKS on Azure in westeurope. It needs a serverless NoSQL data store, a Redis cache, global edge delivery with a CDN. The data is regulated (think PCI/HIPAA-style controls), so apply the strictest sensible security posture. Give us a production-ready architecture that won't need rework.
